checks.note: System prompt, classifier prompt, config and manifest are all read from files under ROOT (/app in the image). The Dockerfile copies prompts, config and release into the image. No URL, database or flag fetch overrides them. The only env var is CLINIC_AGENT_ROOT, which the Dockerfile sets to /app.

/prompts/, /config/, /release/, /src/tools/, /src/control/, /src/audit/, /.github/, /infra/ and /k8s/ are owned by platform leads. The harness in src/agent/ falls under the * catch-all, so it is covered by a code owner, and branch protection requires code-owner review plus 2 approvals. The platform leads do not own src/agent/, which is weaker coverage but not an uncovered path.

The deploy runs only as a workflow_dispatch workflow in the production or production-emergency environment, with required lead reviewers. Production is limited to protected branches, and emergency deploys to hotfix/* only. The AWS role can only be assumed from those two environments. The image signature must come from ci.yml on main, and the git SHA, release and run are annotated on the deployment.
Force pushes and deletions are blocked on main, enforce_admins is on, and signed commits and linear history are required. No bypass is configured.

note: No check could be shown false: prompts and config load from files baked into the image, CODEOWNERS plus branch protection cover the paths, deploys are gated by environments with a recorded SHA and digest, and force-push is blocked.
